notes.title: Update V.1.0.3
notes.content:
Changed the default quality of volumetric lights to improve performance. 

The quality can be changed within the options menu.

notes.title: Update V.1.0.2
notes.content:
- Removed a small collider in the centre of the button, which, by protruding slightly through the surface while the button was pressed, sometimes caused the prism sphere to bounce slightly upwards when placed on the button, causing a call similar to the sphere not pressing the button.

- Repositioned a collider in the upper central part of the button, which serves as an aid to block the prism sphere from rotating, so that it works in exactly the same way, but does not cause the buttons to flicker on and off if the prism sphere is placed in a very specific position, where activation and deactivation calls are triggered in very close succession.

notes.title: Fixed button unpressed with prism spheres
notes.content: - Fixed an occasionally bug with pressure buttons that prevented the activation with the prism's sphere weight.

notes.title: HOSTLIGHT OUT NOW
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are very pleased to announce that Hostlight is now available with an initial 20% discount to celebrate its launch.

You can now start your puzzle adventure in the mysterious tower accompanied by our charming guide, who will help you with the game mechanics and maybe give you some surprises...

Beware, as you progress and climb floors in the tower, you will discover more about the ancient civilisation that built it. Who knows what you might find!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42226548/3c09ee7c76243770010d6386ca35ab5bdda9708c.gif[/img]

Is your brain up for the challenge? 

If so, don't miss the puzzle adventure at Hostlight!

notes.title: Discover Hostlight with its Developers!
notes.content:
Don't know Hostlight yet?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42226548/5836bb5f9218cbafff70c5ac015dae707b6c5d3e.gif[/img]

If you like first-person puzzle games, don't miss this Hostlight stream from the developers.

The levels here revolve around the use of LIGHT and SHADOW, and the creation of objects that help solve the puzzles throughout the game.

In this streaming you can discover the first stages of the game in a gameplay with Miguel E. Ojanguren (modeller, animator and musician of hostlight) and Rubén Barroso (Director and Game Designer), from ESDIP GAMES, with whom you can chat and ask any questions you want.

Don't miss this unique opportunity to discover the wonders of Hostlight this June 18th!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42226548/e4459f30dd3b5a9d1f66ff2c0009f57d62ab22fb.gif[/img]

notes.title: HOSTLIGHT WILL PARTICIPATE ON STEAM'S NEXT FEST JUNE 2022
notes.content:
Attention puzzle lovers!

Hostlight will be participating in the upcoming Steam Next Fest during the week of June 13-20 2022. Don't miss his new demo that you will be able to play from the 13th.

If you want to try the first levels of the game and discover its main mechanics with the use of light and shadow, stay tuned because you will have the Hostlight demo available in no time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42226548/aaa73b1366500a4956fddaa9cf75cc295ff99b20.gif[/img]

Are you ready to climb the tower?

If the answer is yes, don't miss Hostlight at the Steam Next Fest because in addition to the demo, we have a little surprise prepared for the 18th ;)

See you at the festival!
